name: Runtime Storage Cleanup & Hygiene
changes: Safely removes obsolete private SAB admin generations after the authoritative engine is healthy, but only when the directory is non-authoritative and every recorded localhost listener for that generation is proven free.

Normalizes an offline authoritative admin-vN generation back to the canonical sab-engine/admin folder when the old canonical generation is safely removable, preventing historical generation folders from accumulating after clean restarts.

Deletes the retained SABnzbd provisioning ZIP after successful provisioning and removes old v3.5 engine-state repair artifacts and abandoned extraction/download staging files once they are no longer needed.
Bounds sab-startup.log and backend-startup.log to the current file plus two rotated backups instead of allowing startup diagnostics to grow indefinitely.
Exposes cleanup counters in download-engine health telemetry while preserving incoming, incomplete, cache, job ledger, current engine identity, and all active/recoverable queue state.
regression_guards: The authoritative SAB admin directory is never deleted by cleanup, and an occupied historical localhost port always preserves its admin generation for stale-engine quarantine/recovery.
Canonical admin normalization runs only while the authoritative saved port is offline and while the launch lock is held; a live SAB process is never moved underneath itself.
incoming, incomplete, cache, newzdeck-jobs.json, engine.json, engine-identities.json, browser filename recovery state, and lock files are never targeted by runtime-storage cleanup.
v3.6.39 startup-reservation refinement and v3.6.38 crash-recovery/queue-admission protections remain unchanged.
Manual Search/Grab, Newznab behavior, Smart Import, no-downgrade protection, Downloads continuity, and Automation scheduling semantics are unchanged.
